about: The answer key for the review samples: the status each proposal of proposals.json gets with the default settings (gate 0.8, alwaysReview ["new_instance"]), and why.
written: the review writes the statement (or finds it held already). in_review: a review item waits for a person; accepting it writes the statement. refused: the graph cannot hold the statement.
facts: the statements the graph holds after the run, beside the edge it held before (room-014 HAS_EQUIPMENT s11).

p1.why: At the gate or above, about two instances the graph has.

p2.why: The confidence 0.62 is below the gate.

p4.why: The graph holds the edge already: nothing is written again.

p5.why: A value of a property of the ontology, on a room with no area yet.

p6.why: vierzehn is not a value of area_m2 (f64).

p7.why: rdf:type of a new instance: the rule new_instance.

p8.why: The label of a new instance: the rule new_instance.

p9.why: Its object is a new instance: the rule new_instance.

p10.why: Not a relation or a property of the graph's records ontology.

p11.why: HAS_EQUIPMENT points to Equipment; room-014 is a Room.

p12.why: s21 has another name already: a records entity has one name.

p13.why: owl:sameAs is not a relation of the records ontology.
